summary: Greenland Mines Ltd filed an 8-K reporting completion of an acquisition via merger. On September 1, 2026, NNSR Holdings Inc. merged into Merger Sub (Greenland Rare Earths Corp.), with Merger Sub surviving. Consideration was fixed at 1,040,676 newly issued shares of common stock and 359,324 shares of a newly designated preferred series. The deal transferred the Sarfartoq mineral project license in Greenland. No change of control; management remains. Independent Initial Assessment cited project NPV up to ~$2.05 billion pre-tax with 118.6% IRR. Watch integration and license development milestones.
